actual_delegate_results.summary: The Worker write sets are filesystem-disjoint, but the integration contract is not fully disjoint or complete. Ledger loading must duplicate import-side normalized-record validation, while concrete CommonJS entrypoints and the money-helper contract are unspecified. These gaps are likely to cause integration repair unless resolved before Worker implementation.

evidence: interface.md assigns non-overlapping roots: Worker Left owns only src/import/** and Worker Right owns only src/ledger/**.

GOAL.md requires malformed existing ledger records to be rejected, so Worker Right must validate the same dates, currencies, IDs, categories, amount safety, note type, and exact six-field shape normalized by Worker Left; interface.md does not centralize or fully enumerate those validation semantics.

interface.md names parseImportCsv, loadLedger, mergeRecords, writeLedgerAtomic, and monthlyReport but specifies no module filenames or CommonJS export form, leaving Primary-owned cli.cjs without a predetermined require seam.

Worker Left may consume src/money.cjs, but interface.md does not define cents(input) validation and error behavior. The Primary repairs that helper independently, creating avoidable coupling around malformed and unsafe amounts.

interface.md clearly covers transactional merge-before-write, same-directory temporary rename, duplicate/conflict behavior, month validation, safe aggregation, deterministic sorting, and CLI-only process I/O.

acceptance.cjs exercises the principal vertical behavior but not all planned focused edges; the task context correctly assigns additional checks for parser strictness, malformed ledger shapes and duplicates, aggregate overflow, and temporary cleanup.
residual_risks: Define canonical entrypoints and export shapes, for example src/import/index.cjs and src/ledger/index.cjs, before parallel work begins.

Specify one authoritative normalized-record validator contract, including value types, exact-key policy, real-date checks, note requirements, and whether mergeRecords/monthlyReport validate direct inputs. Either assign its ownership explicitly or require equivalent validation with shared fixtures.
Specify the src/money.cjs cents contract: accepted lexical form, safe-range behavior, return type, and thrown errors. This lets Worker Left integrate without depending on the seeded implementation.
Clarify strict UTF-8 decoding ownership at the CLI boundary if malformed byte sequences are intended to be rejected rather than replacement-decoded.
